record.dic_text:
02503 Chelets {kheh'-lets} 或 Chelets {khay'-lets}

源自 02502; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Helez 5; 5

希利斯 = "他已拯救"
1) 一位以法蓮人, 大衛王的卅個大能勇士之一, 統領負責在第七個月的於王室服事的人 
2) 猶大人亞撒利雅的兒子 (#代上 2:39|)
record.edic_text:
02503 Chelets {kheh'-lets} or Chelets {khay'-lets}

from 02502;; n pr m

AV - Helez 5; 5

Helez = "he has saved"
1) an Ephraimite, one of the 30 of David's mighty warriors, leader of
   the 7th monthly course
2) a man of Judah, son of Azariah
